title: Cordless Car Vacuum – Rechargeable & Powerful
descriptionHtml:
Clean the car – without cords and hassle

Crumbs, sand and dust quickly build up in the car and in tight corners. A big corded vacuum rarely reaches all the way in.

Small, cordless and strong

This vacuum is cordless and rechargeable via USB. Despite its small size it has good suction power and easily reaches into crevices and under seats.

Features

  • Cordless and rechargeable via USB
  • Good suction power in a small format
  • Reaches into crevices and tight corners
  • Great for car, home and office
  • Easy to empty and clean

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
